for as former Experiences has Caused some feare, so like☞ wise there is ground of hope; for after that first sealing day as I seesaw heaven opened to receive me (this Comfort & Joy Continued in such a measure, that for A dozen yeares after & more for the most parte, living in the Joyes & love of god, with the sense of his mercie, not being Lefted up nor Cast downe by the world or outward Concerns, & though since, for About A 11 yeares have been Lead in the wilderness to be tempted, yet never to Question wheth[er] in A state of grace, or A Child of Love, but had strong Consolation yt I was A Child of god as well when under the Rod, for these were but fatherly Chastisements.

These & such like were the meditations, Being much raised in praises to god for his Comforts, his frequent vizsits, declaring his Love in Carieing me out of all Sensuall delights, & swallowing me up in his divine Embraceing, even lost in his love; soone after I seesaw an☞ Invisible hand Circle & winde, Round, & move winding higher, and I seesaw a small ireonIronIorn wiere wound Round, I said Lord, yt my Affec
☞ may be alwayes winding up to thee. A little after I seesaw this hand, like A shadow wind Againe up, but not the other Iron thing, but followed it with the eye of faith, & it Ascending winding till it Came to A very great height, yet keept I it in my flam ye: 1eye, at the top was Aflame, I said, ah Lord continually, wind up all my Affections till they flame in love to thee, & that still flam: 2wond heigher then another flame, I said O lord: how delightfull are these flames of love, wch come from thee, & desires alwayesThe Flaming Eye of Eternity to be offered to thee, and it still wond till it came to an Exceeding, flam: 3height, & then a third flame, & there was the flaming eye of Eternity, & this flame was taken into the flaming eye, as into its center, I said lord let me still ascent in flames of love☜ till I come to center in thy blessed Eternall flaming love, this flame was A large circle of Extream bright glittering light. In the middist A peircing eye, as Abided fixed upon me, not in the least moveing offof mee, & I fixed my eye with great Strength & comfort, that this eye of god was allwayes over me and seeaw the Secrets of my heart who knew my whole desire was towards him, & desired this might be my support hereafter that as gods Observing eye was over us, so his preserving eye for our safety being incircled in his power, after this eye was half of it shadowed, with this bright light, like a lid, & it declared☜ so much love, sweetness, meekness, & tender compassion, in the brightness of his love, as did raise in me, so great delight & joy, that gods eye declared, what was in god; as his observation, so his love & security, was allwayes with me.

After some continual delight in this pleasant brightness, I seesaw some small bright figures by the side of this circle of Bright shining glory they were Exceeding bright, like the same brightness as the joyned to, but I knew not what they were, but thought sure, they might be well called angels of light, for they were bright, as all light: this eye of ye trinitie, the circle of light was many hundred times, brighter, and larger yn ye sun in ye skie as we see.

After some considerable time the glory of mount Zion was opened where I seesaw the center of the eye, in the heart of the manifested glroy of the father, in great majesty with a brightness of light about his head, & a Rainbow(& the glory of the sun of god, with the eye Centred in his heart, to declare the trinity, the son in the father & the father in the son. After this i seesaw in A low bush, as growing one the Earth, 7 Eyes contracted together: then I was Instructed that godZech: 3.9. 4.10. was in all things, seeing & observing & securing.

After some time, I turned to rest, & one eye appeared just before me, but not with such a bright glory as the first, but a thin light circleing Round it. I observed it for some time, then another large circleing eye opened like the Second, & had some glimps, at first of the Second but not of the first large bright eye.

This eye had a very thin circle, about it, and ye eye was very peircing, not in the least looking off me, but looking as it were through me, I said O lord thou Canst looke me into nothing, who can stand before thy
thy pure eyes, what am I? (to come to thee) A poore naked spirit Ready to shrink at thy power, but lord cloath me with they garments of my Elder brother, the Robe of Christs Righteousness, & then the peircing of the eye diffused into the white circle, so that it became more thick & whiteish (the circle & the eye became shadowed with love, & sweetness like a lid covering it all over with love, that the eye looked through this lid (this love as shadowed was declared to me to be Jesus Christ, which is the love of the father declared to us, & then what love & sweetness, when gods Justice is covered wth love, & he looketh through the lid which is through his love Jesus Christ, then wee can behold him & goe to him, then I went out of my self in a Beautifull white Robe & after went foreward a little & Ascended by degrees, & went up to this eye, & the eye opened full & as it were Reached downe to take me up & I was taken into the back of the center, & middle of the eye, & after some stay a thin misty☞ body descended, where the other Ascended, full of gold, bright, light specks, as small as specks made with a pen, & came & overshadowed me penetrating throughout, for this I praised god, that as before, I stood a naked spirit, & so could not goe up into god, & having desired the Robe of Christs Righteousness, that was his divine humanitie, that heavenly cloathing, now there was an Acceptance the spirit sent downe to come into me, to make it a body fit to carry up the soule, this had a sweet Reviving quickning & ☞Refreshing of my naked spirit; & after some time thinking all was over, I turned my self more fully to sleep, being as to my body disturbed, & I seesaw this eye lye one the ground as by the bed side with a thick misty circle about it, & the eye very full & plaine in the midist, then I observed, saying isif the lords eye be upon the Earth to observe & preserve? O the safety Las is in this circle, none can come near, nor hurt us.

And this eye was so near as the circle went part of it under the side of the bed, being to large to goe fully under: And after A considerable time the eye gathered up into A Round globe & Ascended to the other eye I had seen, & thay both went, & Entered in the great circling eye of Infinite bright glorious Eternity.

After some delight in these objects I seesaw A shady place. A shadow ☞like a hand circle round, as If it should say observe, & I did & there was a Darke Earth, & the Earth opened & there came forth light; Ah Lord thou art light in darkness, joy in mourning, thou causest darkness to dissappeare, & beyond it in the Element was A black dismall darkness, very black & shut up all all light, & when at blackest, there brakes out a cleare strong light & disperced & made the ☞darkness fly away like A cloud, which made my eyes dazell. (as if I had been in ye sun: finding my eyes dazel I prayed that ye Lord would Enlighten mine eyes that I might farther understand the things concerning my soules welfare.

After I was as in the Country near London, in some feilds, & I felt A driving power to put me forward, & I went towards London, & then in an other place was driven, till I came to my presant habitation, at the
The doore, & then I seesaw him as had driven me set him downe upon the stallsRalls like a watchman, & he Looked down to holbourn, so did I, where I seesaw severall soulders.

div1.head: Wednesday ye 23 of July
div1.p: Being much taken up about what had been Revealed to me ye night before, concerning the eye of gods security, I seesaw my self as the night before at the doore, & the man in the like garb, & like A soulder & watchman, & the souldiers as before (goe up holbourn) after many souldiers came up to hatten garden, & I keept my standing & looked downe & I was standing in the eye of gods power, & a misty circle on the ground Round me spreading at some distance, & the whole company of souldiers came to me, Reaching something like a musket, but i was within the circle, & they reached over it but it would not discharge at mee, many souldiers more close together, the street full, And I had none but ye watcher, & he set still, & I stood still neither of us the least moved or concerned, being well Assured as I was in the circle of security as yt they could not come near nor hurt me, though he seemed to direct the musket to me, & soone after they all went back & fell backward like dead men.

div1.head: Thursday ye 24th of July
div1.p: There were many people behind A forte of Earth, & behind them A thickthese I looked on, as peopelle not in ye body wood, I beheld them as people secured from A Common Enimie. After I seesaw A woman in white cloathing, rise up wth sore eyes, I looked on her & Immediately thought she represented the church In form[er] ages, her eyes were clear, but weake, short sighted, & not to see A far off, clear eyed, & she went down A little way, & vanished. After Another woman Appeared, in white raiment, but very sore eyes, & clear eyed: till at last shee seemed quite blinde, something was so thick on the sight, & she vanished like the other.

After Arose another like A man, whose eyes were very clear, but he had An airy slightly cariage & he vanished, Againe A foweurth Arose & that was In garb like A man In a black or sad coloured cloak wrapped About him, he Appeared very staid, & grave, declaring much of gravity & understanding in his carriage, & after some time, he departed away he was in the figure of Jacob Behmen. friend Mr Sparrow.
